name: renderer
body: Renderer: executes standard Go html/template layouts (the standard-library engine) with the registry's function map: the helpers `media`, `section`, `dict`, `list`, `child` and `children` (template-language, section-helper, dict-list-helpers, child-constructor, children-forwarding) — `section` executes a named section template exactly as if the instance had been authored in Markdown, passing child sections as child arguments and building that instance's context (one-item `.item`, `.raw` from the supplied values, and the child sections the call passes, each executed like an authored instance) and running the target layout; `dict`/`list` construct a map/sequence for field values and `child`/`children` build the child arguments a `section` call uses. Sections render bottom-up: each section instance is executed through its own `layout.html.tmpl`, deepest first, and each parent receives every child section as a list of trusted HTML, one element per child instance; this holds at every depth and for top-level slide sections, so a slide layout receives rendered section HTML rather than data maps. A section template used as a field type stays data-only (typed values, never HTML). Other pre-rendered content: the body and `text` fields are safe HTML; other fields are typed values (number/date formatted per `_format`, boolean, enum, list, image/link URLs); an `image` field renders as the resolved URL of the file it names in its declared roots — for a `media` root the same URL the `media` helper produces, for an `assets` root the deck `assets/` URL (image-field-roots). Builds and passes the reserved context (template-context, item-context, raw-source-context, section-data-context) — `deck` with the deck-wide title/author/date/properties, `slide` with the derived string position label `number` (number + letter for a vertical slide) and the integer `total`, `item` with the current instance's `index`/`number`/`count`/`first`/`last`/`section`/`template`/`depth`/`parent` (nil/absent at slide level; `depth` is the instance's self-nesting depth), `raw` with the author's original source values, and `data` with the authored section tree as data — into the slide layout and into every section instance's execution, at every composition depth; this context is data, not a helper. A bounded-self-nesting chain renders like any other nesting: each instance executes through its template's layout with its own per-level `.item` descriptor (`depth`, `section`, `index`/`count` and `parent` for that level). A `section`-helper invocation renders with a one-item `.item` whose `parent` is the calling instance's fields (nil when the call is made from a slide layout), its `.raw` the values the call supplied, and its `.data` the target's own children populated from the passed child arguments. Layout execute errors become file:line-qualified templates errors. RenderSlide's per-slide `<section>` output is the fragment `kalide render --fragment` writes (cli-render). Whole-deck assembly (theme CSS, reveal.js config, vertical stacks, anchors, notes) is solution.component.deck-renderer.
